title: Cadmies Ecosystem
definition: The interconnected system of technologies and methodologies developed and utilized within the CADMIES knowledge system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of CADMIES as a big garden. It has many parts like a training program, a network of ideas, and tools for sharing. All these parts work together to help us learn and grow.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES ecosystem is a complex system that includes various phases such as concept editing, model training, data validation, and collaboration. It's a network of tools and methodologies designed to facilitate the continuous growth and improvement of the system.
difficulty_levels.expert: The CADMIES ecosystem can be viewed as a dynamic, self-organizing system with an emphasis on open science and collaboration. It's a unique blend of machine learning, graph theory, and human-centered design. By integrating different technologies and methodologies, CADMIES aims to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while also fostering a sense of community and shared learning.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES ecosystem is a self-organizing, interconnected system that facilitates continuous growth, open collaboration, and the integration of various technologies.
